description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Product Master provides a way to interact with the [Product Master (A2X) API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_PRODUCT_SRV/overview). The service allows to create, read, update and delete products, with their descriptions and their plant, sales, procurement, storage, valuation and quality management data.
key-features: Create, read, update and delete products with their basic data, descriptions and units of measure
Maintain plant level data such as MRP, procurement, storage, sales, costing, forecasting and quality management settings
Manage sales, valuation, storage location and accounting data, along with sales, purchase and inspection texts
